q: 我今天的作业已经写___了。
zh: 我今天的作业已经写完了。
py: wǒ jīn tiān de zuò yè yǐ jīng xiě wán le
en: I have already finished writing today's homework.
why: 写完 says the writing reached its end. 会 is for a skill you have learned, and 见 and 懂 belong to seeing, hearing and understanding.

q: 妈妈，饭做___了，可以吃了。
zh: 妈妈，饭做好了，可以吃了。
py: mā ma fàn zuò hǎo le kě yǐ chī le
en: Mum, the food is ready, we can eat now.
why: 好 says the food is done properly and ready to eat. 会 would mean she has learned how to cook, which does not fit a meal that can be eaten now.

q: 我学了三个月，终于学___游泳了。
zh: 我学了三个月，终于学会游泳了。
py: wǒ xué le sān gè yuè zhōng yú xué huì yóu yǒng le
en: After three months of lessons, I finally learned to swim.
why: 学 plus 会 means you studied until you can do it. 见 is only for seeing and hearing, and 到 and 住 say nothing about acquiring a skill.

q: 会议材料我已经准备___了，明天可以用。
zh: 会议材料我已经准备好了，明天可以用。
py: huì yì cái liào wǒ yǐ jīng zhǔn bèi hǎo le míng tiān kě yǐ yòng
en: I have the meeting materials ready; we can use them tomorrow.
why: 准备 takes 好 to say everything is ready for use. 会 and 懂 are about skill and understanding, not about materials being prepared.

q: 这个软件很简单，我看一遍就学___了。
zh: 这个软件很简单，我看一遍就学会了。
py: zhè gè ruǎn jiàn hěn jiǎn dān wǒ kàn yī biàn jiù xué huì le
en: This software is easy; I learned how to use it after one read-through.
why: The point is that I can now use it, and 学会 is exactly that. 完 only says the studying ended, and 着 (zháo) cannot follow 学 here.

q: 这个月的销售数据我们终于整理___了，请大家过来看看。
zh: 这个月的销售数据我们终于整理好了，请大家过来看看。
py: zhè gè yuè de xiāo shòu shù jù wǒ men zhōng yú zhěng lǐ hǎo le qǐng dà jiā guò lái kàn kàn
en: We have finally got this month's sales figures sorted out; please come and take a look.
why: 整理好 means the figures are in order and ready to be looked at. 会 and 懂 describe learning and understanding, not the state of the data.

q: 我们的课十一点半才上___。
zh: 我们的课十一点半才上完。
py: wǒ men de kè shí yī diǎn bàn cái shàng wán
en: Our class doesn't end until half past eleven.
why: 上完 means the class reaches its end. 会 and 好 do not say that a lesson is over, and 上到 would need a stopping point after it, such as a page.

q: 这个星期的事情太多了，我一直到晚上九点才忙___。
zh: 这个星期的事情太多了，我一直到晚上九点才忙完。
py: zhè gè xīng qī de shì qing tài duō le wǒ yī zhí dào wǎn shang jiǔ diǎn cái máng wán
en: There was so much to do this week that I wasn't through with work until nine in the evening.
why: 忙完 means the busy stretch reached its end. 好 would claim the work was done properly, and 会 and 着 do not combine with 忙.

q: 我找了半天，终于找___了我的笔。
zh: 我找了半天，终于找到了我的笔。
py: wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān zhōng yú zhǎo dào le wǒ de bǐ
en: After searching for ages I finally found my pen.
why: The search reached its target, so 找到. 懂 is for understanding, and 完 and 会 do not mean 'found'.

q: 老师说得太快了，我没听___。
zh: 老师说得太快了，我没听懂。
py: lǎo shī shuō de tài kuài le wǒ méi tīng dǒng
en: The teacher spoke too fast and I didn't understand.
why: The problem is understanding, so 听懂. 听见 would mean the sound did not reach me at all, which is not the complaint when someone speaks too fast.

q: 同事在门口叫我，可是我戴着耳机，没听___。
zh: 同事在门口叫我，可是我戴着耳机，没听见。
py: tóng shì zài mén kǒu jiào wǒ kě shì wǒ dài zhe ěr jī méi tīng jiàn
en: A colleague called me from the doorway, but I had headphones on and didn't hear.
why: The sound never registered because of the headphones, so 听见. 听懂 would be about failing to understand words that were heard.

q: 这封邮件我昨天下午就收___了。
zh: 这封邮件我昨天下午就收到了。
py: zhè fēng yóu jiàn wǒ zuó tiān xià wǔ jiù shōu dào le
en: I already received this email yesterday afternoon.
why: 收 gets 到 for 'received', since the item reached me. 见 only follows perception verbs like 看 and 听, and 会 and 懂 do not fit 收.

q: 下课以后，我在图书馆门口看___李老师了，他还跟我打招呼。
zh: 下课以后，我在图书馆门口看见李老师了，他还跟我打招呼。
py: xià kè yǐ hòu wǒ zài tú shū guǎn mén kǒu kàn jiàn lǐ lǎo shī le tā hái gēn wǒ dǎ zhāo hu
en: After class I saw Teacher Li at the library door, and he even said hello.
why: 'Saw' a person is 看见. 看懂 means understood what you read, and 看完 means read to the end, neither of which fits a person.

q: 这篇文章太难了，我看了三遍还是没看___。
zh: 这篇文章太难了，我看了三遍还是没看懂。
py: zhè piān wén zhāng tài nán le wǒ kàn le sān biàn hái shi méi kàn dǒng
en: This article is so hard that I still didn't understand it after reading it three times.
why: Reading something difficult without getting it is 没看懂. 看见 only means the eyes registered something, and 看到 or 看好 do not mean understood.

q: 我想买那本词典，可是跑了三家书店都没买___。
zh: 我想买那本词典，可是跑了三家书店都没买到。
py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi nà běn cí diǎn kě shì pǎo le sān jiā shū diàn dōu méi mǎi dào
en: I wanted that dictionary, but I went to three bookshops and couldn't get a copy.
why: 买到 means the buying reached its goal: you actually got it. 买见 does not exist, and 懂 and 会 are about understanding and skill.

q: 经理昨天发的通知，你们都收___了吗？
zh: 经理昨天发的通知，你们都收到了吗？
py: jīng lǐ zuó tiān fā de tōng zhī nǐ men dōu shōu dào le ma
en: Did you all receive the notice the manager sent yesterday?
why: A notice that was sent is 收到 once it arrives. 收完 would mean finished collecting something, and 会 and 懂 do not go with 收.

q: 他说的是方言，我们一句也没听___，只好请小李帮忙翻译。
zh: 他说的是方言，我们一句也没听懂，只好请小李帮忙翻译。
py: tā shuō de shì fāng yán wǒ men yī jù yě méi tīng dǒng zhǐ hǎo qǐng xiǎo lǐ bāng máng fān yì
en: He was speaking a dialect and we didn't understand a word, so we had to ask Xiao Li to translate.
why: Needing a translator means the words were heard but not understood, so 没听懂. 没听见 would say no sound reached us, which does not call for translation.

q: 对不起，我把你的名字写___了。
zh: 对不起，我把你的名字写错了。
py: duì bu qǐ wǒ bǎ nǐ de míng zi xiě cuò le
en: Sorry, I wrote your name wrong.
why: The apology tells us the writing went wrong, so 写错. 写对 would mean it came out right, which contradicts 对不起.

q: 这道题很难，不过我这次答___了。
zh: 这道题很难，不过我这次答对了。
py: zhè dào tí hěn nán bú guò wǒ zhè cì dá duì le
en: This question was hard, but I got it right this time.
why: 不过 turns the hard question into a success, so 答对. 答错 would continue the difficulty rather than contrast with it, and 懂 and 会 do not follow 答.

q: 字太小了，我戴着眼镜也没看___。
zh: 字太小了，我戴着眼镜也没看清楚。
py: zì tài xiǎo le wǒ dài zhe yǎn jìng yě méi kàn qīng chu
en: The writing was so small I couldn't see it clearly even with glasses on.
why: Small print is a problem of seeing clearly, so 看清楚. 干净 is for cleaning verbs, and 对 and 完 do not describe how clearly something was seen.

q: 衣服太脏了，要多洗几遍才能洗___。
zh: 衣服太脏了，要多洗几遍才能洗干净。
py: yī fu tài zāng le yào duō xǐ jǐ biàn cái néng xǐ gān jìng
en: The clothes are so dirty they need several washes to come out clean.
why: Dirty clothes need to end up clean, so 洗干净. 清楚 is for sight and hearing, and 洗完 would only say the washing ended, not that the dirt is gone.

q: 不好意思，我发___邮件了，应该发给王经理。
zh: 不好意思，我发错邮件了，应该发给王经理。
py: bù hǎo yì si wǒ fā cuò yóu jiàn le yīng gāi fā gěi wáng jīng lǐ
en: Sorry, I sent the wrong email; it should have gone to Manager Wang.
why: The second clause says it should have gone elsewhere, so the sending went wrong: 发错. 发对 would contradict the apology.

q: 请把黑板擦___，下节课要用。
zh: 请把黑板擦干净，下节课要用。
py: qǐng bǎ hēi bǎn cā gān jìng xià jié kè yào yòng
en: Please wipe the board clean; we need it for the next class.
why: 擦干净 means the board ends up clean. 会, 懂 and 着 are not results of wiping.

q: 电话里信号不好，我没听___他说什么，只好请他再说一遍。
zh: 电话里信号不好，我没听清楚他说什么，只好请他再说一遍。
py: diàn huà lǐ xìn hào bù hǎo wǒ méi tīng qīng chu tā shuō shén me zhǐ hǎo qǐng tā zài shuō yī biàn
en: The signal on the phone was bad and I couldn't hear clearly what he said, so I asked him to repeat it.
why: A bad signal makes the sound unclear, so 没听清楚. 干净 is for cleaning, 对 is for right and wrong answers, and 没听完 would mean he had not finished.

q: 请大家记___明天考试的时间。
zh: 请大家记住明天考试的时间。
py: qǐng dà jiā jì zhù míng tiān kǎo shì de shí jiān
en: Everyone, please remember the time of tomorrow's exam.
why: 记住 means to fix it in your memory. 掉, 走 and 光 mean removed, taken away and used up, which is the opposite of keeping it in mind.

q: 昨天晚上我太累了，一躺下就睡___了。
zh: 昨天晚上我太累了，一躺下就睡着了。
py: zuó tiān wǎn shang wǒ tài lèi le yī tǎng xià jiù shuì zháo le
en: I was so tired last night that I fell asleep as soon as I lay down.
why: 睡着 (zháo) is 'fall asleep'. 睡好 would mean slept well, which does not match 'as soon as I lay down'.

q: 教室里太热了，请把窗户打___。
zh: 教室里太热了，请把窗户打开。
py: jiào shì lǐ tài rè le qǐng bǎ chuāng hu dǎ kāi
en: It is too hot in the classroom; please open the window.
why: 打开 means to open something up. 掉 and 走 mean removed and taken away, and 住 means held fixed, none of which opens a window.

q: 这些旧文件没有用了，都扔___吧。
zh: 这些旧文件没有用了，都扔掉吧。
py: zhè xiē jiù wén jiàn méi yǒu yòng le dōu rēng diào ba
en: These old files are useless, so just throw them all away.
why: 扔掉 means to throw something away and be rid of it. 扔开 would be to throw it apart or aside, and 扔住 would mean to hold it.

q: 同事把我的笔借___了，现在我没有笔用。
zh: 同事把我的笔借走了，现在我没有笔用。
py: tóng shì bǎ wǒ de bǐ jiè zǒu le xiàn zài wǒ méi yǒu bǐ yòng
en: A colleague has borrowed my pen and gone off with it, so now I have no pen to use.
why: 借走 means the pen was borrowed and taken away by someone. 借掉 is not used, since 掉 means getting rid of something.

q: 这个月的钱我都花___了，下个月只能省着点儿。
zh: 这个月的钱我都花光了，下个月只能省着点儿。
py: zhè gè yuè de qián wǒ dōu huā guāng le xià gè yuè zhǐ néng shěng zhe diǎn r
en: I've spent all of this month's money; next month I'll have to economize.
why: 花光 means none is left, which explains the need to economize. 花走 and 花开 are not used, and 花住 would not mean spending.

q: 经理说得太快，我一下子没记___。
zh: 经理说得太快，我一下子没记住。
py: jīng lǐ shuō de tài kuài wǒ yī xià zi méi jì zhù
en: The manager spoke so fast that I couldn't take it all in and remember it at once.
why: 没记住 means it did not stay in my memory. 光 and 走 mean used up and taken away, and 开 means open, so none of them fits.

q: 昨天晚上我因为咖啡喝多了，一直没睡___。
zh: 昨天晚上我因为咖啡喝多了，一直没睡着。
py: zuó tiān wǎn shang wǒ yīn wèi kā fēi hē duō le yī zhí méi shuì zháo
en: Last night I'd had too much coffee and couldn't fall asleep.
why: Too much coffee stops you falling asleep: 没睡着 (zháo). 睡完 and 睡会 are not used, and 睡住 means nothing.

q: 小王把桌子上的零食全吃___了，一点儿都没给我留。
zh: 小王把桌子上的零食全吃光了，一点儿都没给我留。
py: xiǎo wáng bǎ zhuō zi shàng de líng shí quán chī guāng le yī diǎn r dōu méi gěi wǒ liú
en: Xiao Wang ate all the snacks on the table and left me nothing.
why: 吃光 stresses that nothing is left, which the second clause confirms. 吃走 is not used, and 住 and 开 do not mean eaten up.

q: 警察对他喊了一声，他马上站___了。
zh: 警察对他喊了一声，他马上站住了。
py: jǐng chá duì tā hǎn le yī shēng tā mǎ shàng zhàn zhù le
en: The policeman called out to him and he stopped on the spot.
why: 站住 means stand still, stop moving. 站开 is not used, and 站掉 and 站着 do not mean stopping.

q: 我把课本放___书包里了。
zh: 我把课本放在书包里了。
py: wǒ bǎ kè běn fàng zài shū bāo lǐ le
en: I put my textbook in my school bag.
why: The book ends up in a place, so 放在 plus the place. 给 needs a person to receive it, 成 needs a new form, and 放走 would mean it was taken away.

q: 老师把作业还___我们了。
zh: 老师把作业还给我们了。
py: lǎo shī bǎ zuò yè huán gěi wǒ men le
en: The teacher gave our homework back to us.
why: Returning something to people is 还给 plus the receiver. 在 needs a place and 成 a new form, and 还完 cannot be followed by 我们.

q: 请把这份中文报告翻译___英文，下午交给经理。
zh: 请把这份中文报告翻译成英文，下午交给经理。
py: qǐng bǎ zhè fèn zhōng wén bào gào fān yì chéng yīng wén xià wǔ jiāo gěi jīng lǐ
en: Please translate this Chinese report into English and hand it to the manager this afternoon.
why: Turning one language into another is 翻译成. 给 needs a receiver and 在 a place, and English is neither.

q: 小李把会议时间写___白板上了。
zh: 小李把会议时间写在白板上了。
py: xiǎo lǐ bǎ huì yì shí jiān xiě zài bái bǎn shàng le
en: Xiao Li wrote the meeting time on the whiteboard.
why: The time ends up on the board, a place, so 写在. 给 would need a person receiving it, and 成 a new form.

q: 我把会议资料发___每个同事了。
zh: 我把会议资料发给每个同事了。
py: wǒ bǎ huì yì zī liào fā gěi měi gè tóng shì le
en: I sent the meeting materials to every colleague.
why: Sending to people is 发给 plus the receiver. 在 is for places, and 成 and 着 do not fit a recipient.

q: 他把一百块钱换___了美元。
zh: 他把一百块钱换成了美元。
py: tā bǎ yī bǎi kuài qián huàn chéng le měi yuán
en: He changed a hundred yuan into US dollars.
why: Money turning into another currency is 换成 plus the new form. 换给 would need a person, and 换住 and 换走 do not give a new form.

q: 对不起，我还___做完这个报告。
zh: 对不起，我还没做完这个报告。
py: duì bu qǐ wǒ hái méi zuò wán zhè gè bào gào
en: Sorry, I haven't finished this report yet.
why: A result that has not happened yet takes 没, as in 还没做完. 不 is for refusing or habits, and 别 is a command.

q: 我上课的时候一直在看手机，所以___听懂老师的话。
zh: 我上课的时候一直在看手机，所以没听懂老师的话。
py: wǒ shàng kè de shí hou yī zhí zài kàn shǒu jī suǒ yǐ méi tīng dǒng lǎo shī de huà
en: I kept looking at my phone in class, so I didn't understand what the teacher said.
why: This is one past occasion, so 没听懂. 不听懂 is not a way to say 'did not understand'.

q: 小王今天早上___找到他的钥匙，所以迟到了。
zh: 小王今天早上没找到他的钥匙，所以迟到了。
py: xiǎo wáng jīn tiān zǎo shang méi zhǎo dào tā de yào shi suǒ yǐ chí dào le
en: Xiao Wang couldn't find his keys this morning, so he was late.
why: The search failed on one past morning, so 没找到. 不找到 would be a refusal or a condition, and 别 is an order.

q: 昨天晚上我没看完___那本书，今天接着看。
zh: 昨天晚上我没看完那本书，今天接着看。
py: zuó tiān wǎn shang wǒ méi kàn wán nà běn shū jīn tiān jiē zhe kàn
en: I didn't finish that book last night, so I'm carrying on with it today.
why: 没 already says the result did not happen, so 了 cannot follow 看完. 过 and 着 do not belong either.

q: 我还没写完___作业，不能出去玩。
zh: 我还没写完作业，不能出去玩。
py: wǒ hái méi xiě wán zuò yè bù néng chū qù wán
en: I haven't finished my homework yet, so I can't go out to play.
why: With 还没 the result has not happened, so the verb gets no 了: 还没写完作业. 了 would clash with 没.

q: 你的作业做完___没有？
zh: 你的作业做完了没有？
py: nǐ de zuò yè zuò wán le méi yǒu
en: Have you finished your homework?
why: The 了没有 question asks whether the result has come about, so 了 follows 做完 and 没有 closes the sentence. 过 would ask about a past experience.

q: 经理要的报告你写___了吗？
zh: 经理要的报告你写完了吗？
py: jīng lǐ yào de bào gào nǐ xiě wán le ma
en: Have you finished writing the report the manager asked for?
why: Asking whether writing reached its end is 写完了吗. 写会 is not used, 写着 would read as zhe, and 写掉 would mean writing it off.

q: 老师，您有没有收___我昨天发的邮件？
zh: 老师，您有没有收到我昨天发的邮件？
py: lǎo shī nín yǒu méi yǒu shōu dào wǒ zuó tiān fā de yóu jiàn
en: Teacher, did you get the email I sent yesterday?
why: Receiving an email is 收到, and 有没有 plus the verb-result is a standard question form. 收见 does not exist, and 会 and 懂 do not go with 收.

q: 我买到___两张去北京的票，明天出发。
zh: 我买到了两张去北京的票，明天出发。
py: wǒ mǎi dào le liǎng zhāng qù běi jīng de piào míng tiān chū fā
en: I managed to get two tickets to Beijing and we leave tomorrow.
why: With a counted object, 了 sits right after the result: 买到了两张票. 过 would mean a past experience, which clashes with leaving tomorrow.

q: 他找到___工作，很高兴。
zh: 他找到了工作，很高兴。
py: tā zhǎo dào le gōng zuò hěn gāo xìng
en: He found a job and is very happy.
why: A completed result takes 了 right after the result 找到. 过 would mean he found one once in the past, which does not explain why he is happy now.

zh: 他没听懂老师的话。
py: tā méi tīng dǒng lǎo shī de huà
en: He didn't understand what the teacher said.
why: 没 goes before the whole 听懂, and the object comes after it or is fronted as the topic. 他听没懂 splits the result from its verb.

zh: 请打开你们的书。
py: qǐng dǎ kāi nǐ men de shū
en: Please open your books.
why: 打开 is one unit and the object follows it. 请 opens the polite command.

zh: 我把书放在桌子上。
py: wǒ bǎ shū fàng zài zhuō zi shàng
en: I put the book on the table.
why: 在桌子上 must follow 放 at once, so the book moves in front of the verb with 把.

zh: 老师把作业还给我们了。
py: lǎo shī bǎ zuò yè huán gěi wǒ men le
en: The teacher gave the homework back to us.
why: 还给 stays together and the receiver 我们 follows it, while the thing returned goes after 把. 了 closes the sentence.

zh: 请把这份报告翻译成英文。
py: qǐng bǎ zhè fèn bào gào fān yì chéng yīng wén
en: Please translate this report into English.
why: 成 needs the new form straight after it, so the report goes in front with 把 and 翻译成英文 stays together.

zh: 同事把会议资料发给每个人了。
py: tóng shì bǎ huì yì zī liào fā gěi měi gè rén le
en: The colleague sent the meeting materials to everyone.
why: 给每个人 follows the verb at once, and the materials go after 把. 了 comes last.

zh: 我们吃完饭就去开会。
py: wǒ men chī wán fàn jiù qù kāi huì
en: As soon as we've eaten, we'll go to the meeting.
why: 吃完饭 keeps the result right after the verb and puts 饭 after it. Because it is the first of two actions, it takes no 了.

zh: 他洗完澡就睡觉了。
py: tā xǐ wán zǎo jiù shuì jiào le
en: He went to bed as soon as he'd had his shower.
why: With the verb-object 洗澡 the result follows the verb part only: 洗完澡. 洗澡完 is not Chinese.

zh: 你做完作业了吗？
py: nǐ zuò wán zuò yè le ma
en: Have you finished your homework?
why: 了 closes the verb-result-object chunk and 吗 turns it into a yes/no question about the result.

zh: 你看见我的手机了吗？
py: nǐ kàn jiàn wǒ de shǒu jī le ma
en: Have you seen my phone?
why: The question uses verb + result + 了 + 吗. 了 may also follow 看见 directly, but never splits 看 from 见.

zh: 她终于找到了满意的工作。
py: tā zhōng yú zhǎo dào le mǎn yì de gōng zuò
en: She finally found a job she was happy with.
why: 了 follows the result 找到, or comes at the very end. It never goes between 找 and 到.

zh: 我还没看完经理发的邮件。
py: wǒ hái méi kàn wán jīng lǐ fā de yóu jiàn
en: I haven't finished reading the email the manager sent.
why: 还没 goes in front of the whole 看完, and the long object either follows or is fronted as the topic. No 了 appears.

zh: 他把我的自行车骑走了。
py: tā bǎ wǒ de zì xíng chē qí zǒu le
en: He rode off on my bike.
why: 骑走 is one unit, with the bike moved in front by 把. 了 closes the sentence and cannot sit between 骑 and 走.

zh: 对不起，我写错了你的名字。
py: duì bu qǐ wǒ xiě cuò le nǐ de míng zi
en: Sorry, I wrote your name wrong.
why: 错 comes straight after 写, and 了 follows 错 or ends the sentence. The English order 'wrongly wrote' does not exist.

zh: 他没看见我。
py: tā méi kàn jiàn wǒ
en: He didn't see me.
why: 没 goes before 看见 as a whole, and no 了 is added. The subject 他 comes first and the object 我 after the verb.

zh: 我没听懂。
py: wǒ méi tīng dǒng
en: I didn't understand.
why: 没 goes before the whole 听懂 and 了 disappears. 不听懂 is not a past negative.

src_py: tā kàn wán nà běn shū le
task: Turn it into a 了没有 question.
zh: 他看完那本书了没有？
py: tā kàn wán nà běn shū le méi yǒu
en: Has he finished that book?
why: The question keeps verb + result + object, then adds 了 and ends on 没有. The fronted topic order is also correct.

src_py: wǒ xiě wán le zhè fèn bào gào
zh: 我把这份报告写完了。
py: wǒ bǎ zhè fèn bào gào xiě wán le
en: I've finished writing this report.
why: With 把 the object moves in front of the verb, and 写完 keeps 完 and takes 了 at the end.

src_py: wǒ sòng le nà běn cí diǎn gěi tā
zh: 我把那本词典送给他了。
py: wǒ bǎ nà běn cí diǎn sòng gěi tā le
en: I gave him that dictionary.
why: 把 puts the dictionary before the verb, so 给他 can follow 送 at once. 了 goes at the end.

src_py: wǒ xiě cuò le nǐ de míng zi
zh: 我把你的名字写错了。
py: wǒ bǎ nǐ de míng zi xiě cuò le
en: I wrote your name wrong.
why: 把 fronts the object and 写错 stays together with 了 after it. 错 never moves ahead of 写.

zh: 我没看见他。
py: wǒ méi kàn jiàn tā
en: I didn't see him.
why: 没 goes before 看见 and 了 drops out. The subject 我 stays first and the object 他 follows the verb.

src_py: wǒ hái méi zuò wán zuò yè
task: Say you have already done it.
zh: 我已经做完作业了。
py: wǒ yǐ jīng zuò wán zuò yè le
en: I've already finished my homework.
why: The positive form drops 没 and adds 了 after the result or at the end. 了 may follow 做完, and the object may be fronted as a topic.

src_py: tā bǎ qián huā guāng le
task: Say he has NOT yet spent it all.
zh: 他还没把钱花光。
py: tā hái méi bǎ qián huā guāng
en: He hasn't spent all the money yet.
why: 还没 goes before 把 and the whole verb + result, and 了 is dropped.

task: Say he is not asleep yet.
zh: 弟弟还没睡着。
py: dì di hái méi shuì zháo
en: My little brother isn't asleep yet.
why: 还没 before 睡着 means the result has not happened yet, and 了 is dropped.

src_py: nǐ zhǎo dào yào shi le
task: Make it a yes/no question with 吗.
zh: 你找到钥匙了吗？
py: nǐ zhǎo dào yào shi le ma
en: Have you found the key?
why: Verb + result + object + 了 + 吗 asks whether the result came about. Fronting the object works too.

src: 我昨天把那份文件发给经理了。
src_py: wǒ zuó tiān bǎ nà fèn wén jiàn fā gěi jīng lǐ le
task: Say you have not yet done it (还没).
zh: 我还没把那份文件发给经理。
py: wǒ hái méi bǎ nà fèn wén jiàn fā gěi jīng lǐ
en: I haven't sent that document to the manager yet.
why: 还没 goes before 把 and the whole verb + result, and 了 disappears. 发给经理 stays together.

src_py: tóng xué men chī guāng le dàn gāo
zh: 蛋糕被同学们吃光了。
py: dàn gāo bèi tóng xué men chī guāng le
en: The cake was eaten up by the classmates.
why: 被 puts the cake first and the agent after 被, while 吃光 stays together before 了.

zh: 我没听清楚。
py: wǒ méi tīng qīng chu
en: I didn't hear clearly.
why: 没 goes before the whole 听清楚, and 了 is dropped.

src_py: tā bǎ zuò yè xiě wán le
zh: 他没把作业写完。
py: tā méi bǎ zuò yè xiě wán
en: He didn't finish his homework.
why: 没 goes before 把, and 了 is dropped, giving 没把作业写完.

src_py: wǒ kàn wán le zhè fēng yóu jiàn
task: Move 了 to the end of the sentence.
zh: 我看完这封邮件了。
py: wǒ kàn wán zhè fēng yóu jiàn le
en: I've finished reading this email.
why: 了 may follow the result or end the sentence, and either way it never separates 看 from 完. Fronting the object also works.

s: 我看书完了。
s_py: wǒ kàn shū wán le
zh: 我看完书了。
py: wǒ kàn wán shū le
en: I've finished reading.
why: 看完 is one unit, so the object 书 cannot stand between 看 and 完. It must come after 看完.

s: 我吃完饭就去图书馆。
s_py: wǒ chī wán fàn jiù qù tú shū guǎn
zh: 我吃完饭就去图书馆。
py: wǒ chī wán fàn jiù qù tú shū guǎn
en: I'll go to the library as soon as I've eaten.
why: This is correct. In 'after A, do B', 吃完饭 normally has no 了, so the missing 了 is not an error.

s: 昨天的课我不听懂。
s_py: zuó tiān de kè wǒ bù tīng dǒng
zh: 昨天的课我没听懂。
py: zuó tiān de kè wǒ méi tīng dǒng
en: I didn't understand yesterday's class.
why: A result that failed on one past occasion takes 没. 不听懂 is not a past negative.

s: 我今天早上没看见李老师。
s_py: wǒ jīn tiān zǎo shang méi kàn jiàn lǐ lǎo shī
zh: 我今天早上没看见李老师。
py: wǒ jīn tiān zǎo shang méi kàn jiàn lǐ lǎo shī
en: I didn't see Teacher Li this morning.
why: This is correct. 没 already says the result did not happen, so no 了 is needed after 看见.

s: 他很累，一躺下就睡觉着了。
s_py: tā hěn lèi yī tǎng xià jiù shuì jiào zháo le
zh: 他很累，一躺下就睡着了。
py: tā hěn lèi yī tǎng xià jiù shuì zháo le
en: He was tired and fell asleep as soon as he lay down.
why: The result 着 attaches to 睡 and 觉 is dropped: 睡着了. 睡觉着 is not Chinese.

s: 我把笔借给小王了。
s_py: wǒ bǎ bǐ jiè gěi xiǎo wáng le
zh: 我把笔借给小王了。
py: wǒ bǎ bǐ jiè gěi xiǎo wáng le
en: I lent my pen to Xiao Wang.
why: This is correct. 借给 is followed at once by the receiver 小王, and the pen is fronted with 把.

s: 我写了完作业，就去打球。
s_py: wǒ xiě le wán zuò yè jiù qù dǎ qiú
zh: 我写完作业，就去打球。
py: wǒ xiě wán zuò yè jiù qù dǎ qiú
en: I'll go and play ball as soon as I've finished my homework.
why: 了 never goes between a verb and its result. 写完 stays together, and 了 would not be needed here anyway.

s: 我上课没听懂，下课以后问了老师。
s_py: wǒ shàng kè méi tīng dǒng xià kè yǐ hòu wèn le lǎo shī
zh: 我上课没听懂，下课以后问了老师。
py: wǒ shàng kè méi tīng dǒng xià kè yǐ hòu wèn le lǎo shī
en: I didn't understand in class, so I asked the teacher afterwards.
why: This is correct. 没听懂 needs no 了, while 问了老师 is a separate completed action with its own 了.

s: 对不起，我打电话错了。
s_py: duì bu qǐ wǒ dǎ diàn huà cuò le
zh: 对不起，我打错电话了。
py: duì bu qǐ wǒ dǎ cuò diàn huà le
en: Sorry, I dialled the wrong number.
why: 错 is a result and must sit right after the verb: 打错. It cannot be left after the object 电话.

s: 我没听懂了老师的话。
s_py: wǒ méi tīng dǒng le lǎo shī de huà
zh: 我没听懂老师的话。
py: wǒ méi tīng dǒng lǎo shī de huà
en: I didn't understand what the teacher said.
why: After 没 the result takes no 了, and 了 never goes between 听懂 and its object. It should be 没听懂老师的话.

s: 经理说的话，你们都听清楚了吗？
s_py: jīng lǐ shuō de huà nǐ men dōu tīng qīng chu le ma
zh: 经理说的话，你们都听清楚了吗？
py: jīng lǐ shuō de huà nǐ men dōu tīng qīng chu le ma
en: Did you all hear clearly what the manager said?
why: This is correct. 听清楚 plus 了吗 is the normal question form, with the topic 经理说的话 fronted.

s: 这些旧资料我已经全部扔掉了，你不用再找了。
s_py: zhè xiē jiù zī liào wǒ yǐ jīng quán bù rēng diào le nǐ bù yòng zài zhǎo le
zh: 这些旧资料我已经全部扔掉了，你不用再找了。
py: zhè xiē jiù zī liào wǒ yǐ jīng quán bù rēng diào le nǐ bù yòng zài zhǎo le
en: I've already thrown out all these old materials, so you needn't look for them any more.
why: This is correct. 扔掉 means thrown away for good, and 了 follows the result, which fits the point that there is nothing left to find.

s: 他把我的蛋糕吃了光。
s_py: tā bǎ wǒ de dàn gāo chī le guāng
zh: 他把我的蛋糕吃光了。
py: tā bǎ wǒ de dàn gāo chī guāng le
en: He ate up my cake.
why: 吃光 is one unit and 了 cannot stand between 吃 and 光. It goes after 光.

s: 请你把这份文件翻译英文，下午交给我。
s_py: qǐng nǐ bǎ zhè fèn wén jiàn fān yì yīng wén xià wǔ jiāo gěi wǒ
zh: 请你把这份文件翻译成英文，下午交给我。
py: qǐng nǐ bǎ zhè fèn wén jiàn fān yì chéng yīng wén xià wǔ jiāo gěi wǒ
en: Please translate this document into English and give it to me this afternoon.
why: With 把 the verb needs a complement, and turning into another language needs 成: 翻译成英文. Bare 翻译英文 is incomplete.

s: 他在书店找了半天，才找到那本词典。
s_py: tā zài shū diàn zhǎo le bàn tiān cái zhǎo dào nà běn cí diǎn
zh: 他在书店找了半天，才找到那本词典。
py: tā zài shū diàn zhǎo le bàn tiān cái zhǎo dào nà běn cí diǎn
en: He searched the bookshop for ages before he found that dictionary.
why: This is correct. 找了半天 describes the searching, and 找到 describes the finding. Each verb carries what it needs.

s: 我把今天的会议材料放了在经理的桌子上。
s_py: wǒ bǎ jīn tiān de huì yì cái liào fàng le zài jīng lǐ de zhuō zi shàng
zh: 我把今天的会议材料放在经理的桌子上了。
py: wǒ bǎ jīn tiān de huì yì cái liào fàng zài jīng lǐ de zhuō zi shàng le
en: I put today's meeting materials on the manager's desk.
why: 了 cannot come between 放 and 在. It goes at the end of the sentence.

s: 昨天的作业太多了，我写到十二点还没写完。
s_py: zuó tiān de zuò yè tài duō le wǒ xiě dào shí èr diǎn hái méi xiě wán
zh: 昨天的作业太多了，我写到十二点还没写完。
py: zuó tiān de zuò yè tài duō le wǒ xiě dào shí èr diǎn hái méi xiě wán
en: There was so much homework yesterday that I was still writing at twelve and hadn't finished.
why: This is correct. 写到十二点 gives the time reached, and 还没写完 shows the result had not come about, so no 了.

s: 经理要的报告你写完没有了？
s_py: jīng lǐ yào de bào gào nǐ xiě wán méi yǒu le
zh: 经理要的报告你写完了没有？
py: jīng lǐ yào de bào gào nǐ xiě wán le méi yǒu
en: Have you finished writing the report the manager wanted?
why: In the 了没有 question, 了 comes right after 写完 and 没有 closes the sentence. 没有了 reverses them.

s: 他不吃完饭，妈妈就不让他出去玩。
s_py: tā bù chī wán fàn mā ma jiù bù ràng tā chū qù wán
zh: 他不吃完饭，妈妈就不让他出去玩。
py: tā bù chī wán fàn mā ma jiù bù ràng tā chū qù wán
en: If he doesn't finish his meal, his mother won't let him go out to play.
why: This is correct. 不 before verb + result is right for 'if not', and 不吃完饭 sets the condition for the 就 clause.

s: 他昨天不收到我的邮件，所以没来。
s_py: tā zuó tiān bù shōu dào wǒ de yóu jiàn suǒ yǐ méi lái
zh: 他昨天没收到我的邮件，所以没来。
py: tā zuó tiān méi shōu dào wǒ de yóu jiàn suǒ yǐ méi lái
en: He didn't receive my email yesterday, so he didn't come.
why: 昨天 marks one past occasion, so the negative is 没收到. 不收到 is not a past negative.
